Asha (PM): quick huddle — Acme pilot: private deploy target next sprint. need a minimal handoff checklist and owners. who can take what?
Ken (Runtime): runtime needs: model variant confirmed (13B), quantization plan, and prewarm for critical routes. can do perf delta in 48h.
Priya (Infra): infra needs: VPC peering, subnet for reserved GPUs, PO for vendor. network diagram + slot request 24h. provisioning 5-7bd after PO.
Marco (Security): KMS required. for pilot customer can accept Redwood-managed keys if we document rotation; CMK adds ~3d. need SIEM ingest and audit checklist.
Zoe (Eng PM): propose "slim MVP": tenant isolation + encryption, p95 <1s on primary routes (5% canary), documented hosted fallback if PO delayed, SOC2 evidence stub.
Noah (SRE): SLOs and dashboards: p95/p99, error-rate, GPU mem pressure. will stub dashboards in 24h and provide rollback script in 48h.
Jenna (Solutions): I'll confirm customer acceptance on hosted fallback and CMK flexibility by EOD.
Asha (PM): actions -> product: finalize eval set; runtime: quant + fallback; infra: network + PO; security: KMS + audit; SRE: dashboards + rollback. owners: Priya deploy, Ken perf signoff, Marco security signoff, Asha customer signoff.
Ken (Runtime): risk: quant regressions. mitigation: AB eval + auto-fallback to FP16 if quality delta > threshold.
Priya (Infra): alternative if PO late: route 5% canary to hosted region (with consent). needs product signoff.
Asha (PM): product signoff agreed for documented fallback for pilot. Jenna to get Acme approval.
Zoe (Eng PM): timeline sketch if all ETAs met:
Day 0: eval + approvals
Day 1: infra diagram + dashboards stub + KMS options
Day 2-3: quant perf + PO submission
Day 4: provision reserved pool (vendor permitting) + 5% canary
Day 5: 24h observation gate + chaos check
Day 6-7: limited ramp
Asha (PM): please drop ETA confirmations in this thread by EOD. I'll assemble a one-pager for Acme. :handshake:
